_comment: Simulation tool floors and pins (issue #4). Read by scripts/setup-env.sh. The ngspice floor is 44 because openvaf-r emits OSDI ABI 0.4, which ngspice-43 and earlier reject; Ubuntu 24.04's apt ngspice-42 is below it, so setup-env.sh builds the pinned ngspice inside the checkout (never on the host).

openvaf.source: fetched and sha256-verified by klayout-tools scripts/fetch-sg13g2-sim-toolchain.sh; these values are cross-checked against that script by scripts/setup-env.sh
